title: Ezure's Visionary Modpack
description: A Modpack aimed at giving more progression to minecraft while also adding quality of life content
body:
This modpack is made for what i personally think would suit modern minecraft in terms of progression and quality of life features, this pack also adds over 300+ mods!!

Some of the mods in this modpack include:
- Create Mod
- The Aether
- Better End
- YUNGS Structures
- And Many More!!

(And a secret spooky mod in there for fun..)


NOTE: This modpack will be updated over time to newer versions, currently no plans to backport however i will be removing and adding mods as time goes on to improve the experience.
